generalExcellenceNote: The general-excellence pass on 2026-08-18 surfaced 30 acclaimed London restaurants absent from the sheet. They cluster into two gaps rather than thirty individual misses: (1) WEST AFRICAN, where Ikoyi holds two Michelin stars and Chishuru and Akoko one each - currently tier 3, which the evidence contradicts; and (2) the MODERN EUROPEAN fine-dining tasting-menu tier, which fell between the British pass (traditional British) and the Modern European cuisine (3 rows). Bouchon Racine, the National Restaurant Awards number one in the UK, was missed by every cuisine pass.
